# 3 bed penthouse for sale

> Set within the prestigious Woodlands Grove development, this penthouse stands out as one of Blackrock’s most impressive new homes. This 3-bedroom penthouse is extending to approx. 178 sq.m / 1,916 sq.ft. Fully designed and fitted out by renowned interior designer Helen Turkington, commanding a rare sense of privacy, luxury and refinement, with every detail crafted to the highest specification.
